 ATP Almaty Best Bets Including Daniil Medvedev Vs Terence Atmane 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The 2026 ATP Almaty tournament moves into the quarterfinals in Kazakhstan. This is a 250-point tournament, so unlike the 1,000-point tournament in Shanghai or the 500-point tournaments coming up in Europe, this is not a huge prize in the race for the ATP Finals in Turin, Italy. The players in contention for an ATP Finals berth need to rest up so that they can make a run at the 500s and at the one remaining 1,000-point event in Bercy (France). They can’t play every week, and they know that as the tour moves from Asia back to Europe, they have to regroup for what’s ahead. This ATP Almaty tournament is for players who are lower on the food chain, trying to get some wins, some matches, prize money, and points as a building block going into the start of the 2027 season. The big dogs have to take a break. This is going to be an event where players outside the top 20 try to build their ranking and add to their 2026 prize money before the season ends. LWOS has our best bets for four matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments.
 ATP Almaty 
 Stefanos Tsitsipas – James Duckworth: 4:00 EST 
 H2H: 1-0 
 This ATP Almaty match features Stefanos Tsitsipas, who is 8-2 in his last 10 matches and is back to playing good tennis after a long period of struggle. Tsitsipas hopes to carry his current form into the start of 2027 and return to being a contender for the biggest titles in tennis. James Duckworth is only 4-6 in his last 10 matches. He has won two straight matches after having lost five in a row not that long ago.
 Best Bet to Make 
 Welcome to our best bet section. You’re going to get a collection of bets to consider, also a confidence level which should guide how much you should invest in this match. 
 Parlay/hedge options: Duckworth +4 games at 1.67 at @1xbet 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 4 – You could bet half a unit on this match.  
 This ATP Almaty match should lean to Tsitsipas, given his superior current form compared to the struggling Duckworth. Don’t make it a huge bet, but you should certainly put something on the Greek, given how well he is performing at the moment.
 That being said, betting on Tsitsipas -1.5 sets is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Tsitsipas -1.5 sets at 1.72 at @1xbet 
 Nikoloz Basilashvili – Adrian Mannarino: 2:30 EST 
 H2H: 1-3 
 This ATP Almaty match is a rematch of a very recent meeting in Shanghai. Adrian Mannarino won the first set 6-3. Then, at 2-2 in the second set, Nikoloz Basilashvili retired. Mannarino leads the head-to-head 3-1, but Basilashvili is the sportsbook favorite at 1.77. Are the books on the right side of this one? Mannarino just beat Andrey Rublev and is in good form right now.
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Basilashvili moneyline at 1.77 at @betfair 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 1 – you should not bet on this match. 
 This ATP Almaty match could go in any direction. Mannarino winning in Shanghai could be used to justify a pro-Mannarino pick, but the fact that Basilashvili retired could be used to devalue that result. Mannarino’s win over Rublev is a reason to back him against Basilashvili, but maybe the familiarity of the matchup (having met a short time ago) will enable Basilashvili to make adjustments. It’s not a good match to bet on, but we’re going to lean Mannarino because of the head to head and his strong current form.
 That being said, betting on Mannarino +2.5 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Mannarino +2.5 games at 1.76 at @unibet 
 Aug 10, 2022; Montreal, QC, Canada; Adrian Mannarino (FRA) hits a forehand against Jannik Sinner (ITA) (not pictured) in second round play at IGA Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Eric Bolte-USA TODAY Sports | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Yesh Ginsburg 
 Danill Medvedev – Terence Atmane: 5:30 EST 
 H2H: 2-0 
 This ATP Almaty match features the in-form Daniil Medvedev, who made the semifinals in Shanghai and is playing Almaty to continue to pick up points for the ATP Finals. Medvedev is trying to nail down one of the last spots in the eight-man field, so he is urgently trying to stack wins and add points to gain safety going into November. Terence Atmane is a talented but inconsistent player. He fits the category of “on any given day, he can be dangerous,” but he hasn’t maximized his potential as a tennis player.
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Medvedev -1.5 sets at 1.70 at @interwetten 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 1 – you should not bet on this match. 
 This ATP Almaty match feels like a live wire, a match which could go in any of several directions. It’s not a great match to bet on, but if you insist, we think Atmane keeps it close enough to cover the game spread.
 That being said, betting on Atmane +4 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Atmane +4 games at 1.75 @1xbet 
 Alexander Bublik – Karen Khachanov: 10:30 EST 
 H2H: 1-1 
 This ATP Almaty match offers a clear contrast. Alexander Bublik advanced to the quarterfinals when his opponent, Fabian Marozsan, gave him a walkover. Bublik did not play in the Round of 16. Karen Khachanov, on the other hand, won his Round of 16 match in a close third-set tiebreaker. One player is coming into this match cold, while the other is coming off an extended-length match. Will Bublik’s rest or Khachanov’s stressful test offer better preparation for this quarterfinal?
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Bublik moneyline at 1.79 at @pinnacle 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 1 – you should not bet on this match. 
 This ATP Almaty match could go in any direction. Bublik getting rest in the previous round could make him hungrier and more energetic, but he could also be out of rhythm against Khachanov, who came through a tough match in his previous round and might hit more freely in this quarterfinal versus Bublik. Don’t bet on this one, but if you insist, we will lean to Khachanov on the game spread.
 That being said, betting on Khachanov +2.5 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Khachanov +2.5 games at 1.60 @betfair
